mapper.sql: t.id, t.title, t.description, t.priority, t.status, t.assignee_user_id, t.created_by_user_id, t.due_date, t.started_at, t.completed_at, t.approved_by_user_id, t.approved_at, t.related_type, t.related_id, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, a.nick_name as a_name, c.nick_name as c_name, p.nick_name as p_name
from nad_task t left join sys_user a on a.user_id = t.assignee_user_id left join sys_user c on c.user_id = t.created_by_user_id left join sys_user p on p.user_id = t.approved_by_user_id
mapper.insert: insert into nad_task (title, description, priority, status, assignee_user_id, created_by_user_id, due_date, started_at, completed_at, approved_by_user_id, approved_at, related_type, related_id, create_by, create_time) values (#{title}, #{description}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{assigneeUserId}, #{createdByUserId}, #{dueDate}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{approvedByUserId}, #{approvedAt}, #{relatedType}, #{relatedId}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update nad_task set title = #{title}, description = #{description}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId}, due_date = #{dueDate}, started_at = #{startedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, approved_by_user_id = #{approvedByUserId}, approved_at = #{approvedAt}, related_type = #{relatedType}, related_id = #{relatedId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
